description: Creates and revises a Claude Code subagent definition — the markdown file under `agents/`, its frontmatter, its system prompt, its tool grant, and the description that decides when Claude delegates to it. Use when a subagent is the artifact being produced: drafting one, narrowing a tool grant wider than the job needs, adding delegation examples, or fixing an agent Claude never delegates to. Do not use when the artifact is a SKILL.md, a hook, an MCP server, a slash command, or the plugin carrying them — skill-creator, hook-creator, mcp-creator, command-creator and create-plugin own those. Do not use to audit a subagent without changing it: agent-reviewer does that read-only.
